channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Romania Cancels ID Cards For 100,000 Moldovans Amid Fictitious Address Scam
item.description: Romania has canceled identity papers for 100,000 dual Romanian-Moldovan citizens in response to scams that have lasted for years.

item.title: Witkoff Says Trump 'Curious' Why Iran Hasn't 'Capitulated'
item.description: Washington's special envoy, Steve Witkoff, has said US President Donald Trump has questioned why Tehran has not "capitulated" in the face of a massive buildup of the US military near Iran.

item.title: Zelenskyy: Moscow Invests In Strikes, Not Diplomacy
item.description: Overnight, Russia launched 50 missiles and 297 drones across Kyiv and six other regions, hitting energy, transport, and residential sites, he said.

item.title: Explosion Rocks Major Russian Oil Pipeline Facility In Tatarstan
item.description: A key oil pumping station in Russia's Tatarstan region was rocked by an explosion overnight on February 22-23. The facility is a hub for Russia's energy sector and the Druzhba pipeline, which carries oil to Europe. Russian authorities claim the blast was caused by falling debris from a drone attack.

item.title: Exiled Kurdish Groups Form New Alliance As They Seek To Capitalize On Iran's Frailty
item.description: Five Iranian Kurdish groups based in Iraq have announced that they have formed a political coalition aimed at overthrowing the Islamic republic and ultimately achieving Kurdish autonomy.

item.title: Iranian Students Reignite Anti-Government Protests For Third Day
item.description: Iranian students held anti-government protests at several universities for the third consecutive day, according to videos published online and verified by RFE/RL.

item.title: Hungary, Slovakia Block New EU Sanctions On Russia
item.description: The European Union has failed to agree on more sanctions on Russia as planned by the fourth anniversary of the Kremlin's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Iranian Students Protest For Third Day Calling For Regime Change
item.description: Hundreds of Iranian students have held protests for a third straight day on at least six university campuses, demanding respect for human rights and calling for regime change. Some chanted "Women, life, freedom!" on February 23, while crowds at Al-Zahra University called for regime change.

item.title: 'Not AI': Ukraine Fights To Debunk Russia's Battlefield Claims
item.description: Russia's military claimed to have taken the city of Kupyansk while Ukraine insisted it remained under Kyiv's control. Then Moscow claimed a nearby town, prompting a Ukrainian officer to post videos of himself walking there, which in turn set off Russian accusations that his post was AI-generated.

item.title: Ukraine Enters 5th Year Of Russia's Full-Scale War Amid Both Talks And Fighting
item.description: Ukraine has entered the fifth year of Russia’s all-out invasion, the largest armed conflict in Europe since World War II, with its troops holding the line from grinding attacks in frozen trenches while its civilians face nightly mass drone and missile strikes.
